finalText:
I deleted 22 of the 24 stickies in the Done section; the other 2 are locked, so I left them. Afterwards a final automatic check failed, and I didn't make the change it asked for.

**What changed:** The 22 unlocked stickies are gone. Three arrows started on deleted stickies: one that pointed to "the first-run sign-in loops twice" and two more. Their start ends now sit at a fixed spot on the board instead.

**What I left alone:** The 2 locked stickies, "fixed the double sign-in" (Ivana) and "renamed Publish button" (Marek), are still there. To remove them, unlock them (⇧⌘L) and delete them, or ask me to. The Done section itself and everything else on the board are unchanged.

**The failed check:** The final check flagged 278 existing board items, including those two locked stickies, as new. It asked me to mark them all as written by AI. That's wrong: they were written by Tereza, Jonas, Ivana, Marek and Petra, and the changes show nothing was added, only deleted. Relabelling them would show the wrong author and would mean editing the locked ones. The regular file check on the board passes. The final check probably had no saved earlier copy of the board to compare against, so you can treat that failure as a false alarm.
